rioja.overview: Rioja offers modest but scenic walking, blending agricultural landscapes with the rugged backdrop of the Sierra de Cantabria. Most routes are gentle to steady day hikes that start directly from the wine towns, leading through rolling vineyards and along the Ebro River. The best walking is in spring and autumn, avoiding the intense summer heat and cold winters.

months.1: Winter brings cold temperatures and occasional snow to the valley. Walking is limited to brisk strolls on the farm tracks between bare vineyards.
months.5: This is a prime month for walking, with comfortable temperatures for the steady trails up into the Sierra de Cantabria for panoramic views over the wine country.
months.12: Cold weather sets in, with occasional snow. The walking is stark, limited to short outings near the towns.

rivieramaya.overview: The Riviera Maya's walking is flat and easy: jungle paths and coastal trails. The best are short nature trails around cenotes and the shaded dirt paths linking the ancient ruins at Coba.

months.1: The dry season brings comfortable temperatures for the flat jungle trails around Coba and the local cenotes.
months.2: Dry, comfortable days continue, and the shaded paths between the Coba ruins are pleasant for an easy walk.
months.3: Warmth builds, but mornings stay comfortable on the flat jungle trails and cenote paths.
months.7: Daily downpours keep the jungle paths wet, and mosquitoes thrive in the humid air.
months.8: Hurricane season and intense humidity make walking uncomfortable, with many jungle trails waterlogged.
months.9: Hurricane risk is at its peak, and storms can leave the jungle trails waterlogged for days.
months.10: Humidity remains heavy and storm risk lingers, so waterlogged trails are common.

rocky-mountain.overview: Rocky Mountain National Park has alpine day hiking, with trails climbing past glacier-carved lakes to high tundra ridges. Hikers drive or take a shuttle to trailheads like Bear Lake, where steep routes push above the treeline to sweeping views of the Continental Divide. In 2026 a timed-entry reservation was required from late May to mid-October.

months.1: Deep snow covers the park, closing the high alpine routes. Walkers can snowshoe or use winter traction on the lower valley trails around Bear Lake.
months.2: Winter holds on, with deep snow across the high country. Snowshoes and traction devices suit the lower valley trails near Bear Lake.
months.3: Snow lingers, though lower trails see some melt on warm afternoons. Snowshoes and winter traction are still the right tools around Bear Lake.
months.12: Snow deepens across the park and the high routes stay closed. Snowshoes and traction devices open up the lower valley trails around Bear Lake.
months.8: High tundra and ridgelines stay open, and the long days allow big mileage to the glacier lakes and viewpoints. Afternoon thunderstorms can build over the high country, so start early. A timed-entry reservation is required.

months.1: Cool and occasionally damp weather suits easy winter walks along the ancient stones of the Appian Way.
months.12: Mild but unpredictable winter weather offers atmospheric walks along the ancient aqueducts on clear days.

rwanda.overview: Rwanda offers steep, muddy volcano climbs and dense forest trails that go with park guides. In Volcanoes National Park, hikers climb Mount Bisoke or Mount Karisimbi, or take the muddy trail to Dian Fossey's grave. Further south, Nyungwe National Park provides a network of trails through ancient montane rainforest.

months.7: Dry weather makes July an excellent time to hike. The steep climbs up Mount Bisoke and Mount Karisimbi are far more manageable with firmer footing.
months.11: Rain is frequent, making the volcano climbs and forest trails muddy, slippery, and much harder work.

months.1: Winter brings cool, often windy and damp weather. The caldera path is walkable, though the views can be clouded and many island facilities are closed.
months.2: Cool and breezy conditions continue. The rim path is open for those who do not mind the chill, offering stark views of the caldera.
months.12: Winter conditions set in, with cool, windy, and sometimes damp days. The rim path is open, but the weather can obscure the views.
